channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Tag! Queer Shorts Festival 2027: Call for Submissions (Portland) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Tag! Queer Shorts Festival
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026
Award: Award categories with cash prizes (amounts not stated): Hispanic/Latine Creativity, Power of Community, Best Erotic Short and Radical Futures Student Film, plus a Festival Director's Award. Modest submission fees on FilmFreeway; fee waivers for historically excluded communities and filmmakers from countries that criminalize queer identities, and discount codes for Pacific Northwest filmmakers.

Tag! invites LGBTQIA+ filmmakers to submit finished shorts of 15 minutes or under, including credits, in any genre (theme for 2027: "You're It!"). About 40 to 45 shorts are selected. English captions are required; films made with generative AI are not programmed; no works in progress.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Erase Indifference Challenge 2026 (Auschwitz Pledge Foundation; EUR 90,000 in awards for projects countering hate) (closes 4 Dec)
item.description:
Auschwitz Pledge Foundation
Deadline: 4 Dec 2026
Award: EUR 90,000 in total: one EUR 20,000 Main Award plus seven EUR 10,000 awards. Unrestricted, no reporting requirement. No application fee.

The annual Erase Indifference Challenge rewards existing projects that move bystanders to act against discrimination and hate, through art, education or technology.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Material Works Art Award 2026 (USD 2,500 acquisition award) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
Material Works Art
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026
Award: One USD 2,500 award in exchange for an original artwork that joins the Material Works collection. Application review fee USD 40.

Material Works Art, a privately backed, artist-run project platform and contemporary art collection in Chicago, gives one artist a USD 2,500 award in exchange for an original artwork of similar value, which joins the collection and is considered for future exhibitions.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Sam Raimi Horror Short Film Award (Decentralized Pictures) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
Decentralized Pictures
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026
Award: USD 25,000 production award for one horror short, plus mentorship, marketing support and distribution on DCP+. Submission fee USD 25 (paid to community reviewers).

Decentralized Pictures and Sam Raimi are funding a horror short: the selected project receives a USD 25,000 production award plus mentorship, marketing support and distribution on Decentralized Pictures' DCP+ platform.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Leiden Shorts 2027: International and National Competition Submissions (closes 11 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Leiden Shorts International Film Festival
Deadline: 11 Jan 2027
Award: Jury financial award (amount not stated) and an Audience Award. Fees EUR 15.50 regular / EUR 22 last chance (Brand New Eyes debut and student strand EUR 12.50 / 19).

Leiden Shorts takes short films up to 30 minutes completed after 1 January 2026, in all genres including animation, for its International and National Competitions and the Brand New Eyes strand for debuts and student films. Works in progress are accepted if finished before April 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: The Whickers Film & TV Funding Award 2027 (GBP 120,000 for a first feature documentary) (closes 22 Jan 2027)
item.description:
The Whickers
Deadline: 22 Jan 2027, 12:00 GMT
Award: GBP 120,000 main award; GBP 25,000 development award for the runner-up. Free to enter.

The Whickers Film & TV Funding Award backs a director-led documentary by a first-time feature director. The winner receives GBP 120,000 and the runner-up a GBP 25,000 development award.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Vienna Shorts 2027: Film Submissions (closes 31 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Vienna Shorts
Deadline: 31 Jan 2027
Award: About EUR 30,000 in awards (EUR 1,500 to 6,000 per competition); screening fees paid for non-competitive selections. Fees: Animation Avantgarde EUR 13, Fiction and Documentary EUR 19, non-competitive EUR 10, Austrian entries EUR 5 (plus EUR 10 in the late window).

Vienna Shorts, an Oscar-, BAFTA- and European Film Awards-qualifying short film festival, takes films up to 30 minutes completed after 1 January 2026, including the international Animation Avantgarde competition for animation and experimental film.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: 2nd Aion Digital Art Prize 2026-27 (digital, video, animation, sound, XR) (closes 1 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Aion Laboratory (Ise-Shima Art Company)
Deadline: 1 Mar 2027, 23:59 UTC
Award: Grand Prize JPY 50,000 plus certificate; up to 35 further prizes are certificates only. Entry fee JPY 3,000 per work, non-refundable.

The Aion Digital Art Prize, run by Aion Laboratory of the Ise-Shima Art Company in Japan, is an open award for digital and media art: digital images, video, animation, sound, AR/VR and related practices.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Iris Prize 2027: International LGBTQ+ Short Film Prize (GBP 40,000) (closes 2 Jun 2027)
item.description:
Iris Prize
Deadline: 2 Jun 2027
Award: GBP 40,000 for the winner to make their next short film in the UK; smaller UK-only awards (Community and Education GBP 250, Micro Short GBP 100). Submission fee not stated on the official page; Iris alumni get a full waiver.

Billed as the world's largest LGBTQ+ short film prize, the Iris Prize international shorts strand is open worldwide; the Best British, student, community and education strands are UK only. Submissions open 11 January 2027; deadlines: early bird 31 March, regular 24 May, late 2 June 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: BBBank Award in Projection Mapping 2027: PLAYGROUND (ZKM, SCHLOSSLICHTSPIELE Karlsruhe) (closes 25 Nov)
item.description:
ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe, with BBBank and SCHLOSSLICHTSPIELE Karlsruhe
Deadline: 25 Nov 2026, 13:00 CET
Award: EUR 10,000 prize if the selected concept is realised, plus EUR 10,000 production funding covering fees and technology. No application fee.

Open call for a 7-minute projection mapping on the Karlsruhe palace facade, on the 2027 festival theme Playground (The Art of Playing). For artists, designers, studios and collectives working in projection mapping; ZKM provides curatorial and technical coaching.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Sony Future Filmmaker Awards 2027 (Fiction, Non-Fiction, Animation, Immersive, Future Format) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Sony Group
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026, 07:00 CST
Award: USD 5,000 cash to each winner of Fiction, Non-Fiction, Animation and Immersive (180/360); USD 2,500 for Future Format. The Student category awards equipment only.

A free international short film competition run by Sony, with an Immersive category for 180 and 360 degree work alongside Fiction, Non-Fiction, Animation and Future Format. Films must have been released between 1 January 2025 and 15 December 2026, in English or subtitled.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: 51st Hong Kong International Film Festival 2027: Call for Entries (features, documentaries, Short Film Competition) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
Hong Kong International Film Festival Society (HKIFF)
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026
Award: EXCEPTION: NOT FUNDED (festival call). Selection for one of Asia's oldest film festivals and its competitions; prize amounts not stated in the call. Entry fees from 4 November to 31 December 2026: Short Film Competition (under 20 minutes) USD 50 / HKD 390; all other categories USD 80 / HKD 624. Fee waiver for documentaries by directors holding a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card. Fees non-refundable.

The Hong Kong International Film Festival, one of Asia's oldest film festivals, is taking submissions for its 51st edition (16-29 March 2027).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Chroma Awards: Season 2 (AI film, music video and game competition) (closes 7 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Chroma Awards (incubated by ElevenLabs, with 100+ AI tool sponsors)
Deadline: 7 Jan 2027, 23:45 PST
Award: USD 263,750 in cash across divisions per the official page (Film/TV USD 38,000, Ad USD 35,000, Music Video USD 24,000, Game USD 20,500, Behind-the-Scenes USD 17,000, Student about USD 55,000-60,500). Organisers also advertise USD 450,000+ including sponsor tool credits and travel perks. Free to enter.

Season 2 of the Chroma Awards, a global competition for work made with generative AI tools, across film and TV, advertising, music video, game, behind-the-scenes and student divisions. Any AI tools may be used; projects must have been made after 1 February 2026. No age or country restriction found.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fondation Francois Schneider: Talents Contemporains 16th Edition - Water
item.description: Fondation Francois Schneider · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · EUR 15,000 per laureate (merit prize plus acquisition of the work; EUR 8,000 when the work is part of a multiple edition, e.g. photo or video); up to 7 laureates. Sculpture and installation projects can additionally receive up to EUR 50,000 in production assistance. No entry fee stated.

item.title: Judson-Morrissey Excellence in New Media Award 2026 (BIPOC students)
item.description: New Media Caucus · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Multiple unrestricted awards of varying amounts up to USD 500 each, funded through donor contributions. Awardees are also featured in an NMC Header/Footer Gallery exhibition and a digitally published interview. Free to apply.

item.title: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen: Call for Films, 73rd Festival (2027)
item.description: Internationale Kurzfilmtage Oberhausen (International Short Film Festival Oberhausen) · deadline 18 Jan 2027 · International Competition: Grand Prize of the City of Oberhausen EUR 8,000, Principal Prize EUR 4,000, Promotional Prize EUR 1,500, plus a European Film Awards short film nomination. German Competition: EUR 5,000 main prize, EUR 1,500 promotional, EUR 2,500 3sat Emerging Talent Prize (with purchase offer), EUR 1,000 ZONTA Prize for a female filmmaker. NRW Competition: EUR 1,000 and EUR 500 prizes, plus NRW Ministry prizes of EUR 5,000 and EUR 3,000, FIPRESCI Prize, EUR 2,000 Ecumenical Jury Prize, EUR 750 WDR Westart Audience Jury Prize. Children's and Youth: several EUR 1,000-1,500 prizes and an ECFA Short Film Award nomination. Prizes go to the directors. SUBMISSION FEE: first five submissions per submitter are free; EUR 20 handling fee per film from the sixth.
